notes: Normal series before mode-mask controls use the original executables, preserved beside the rebuilt binaries as slang-rhi-tests-binding-pre-mask.exe.
Mode-mask controls use rebuilt executables with the same benchmark-only change on both revisions. Per-series executable hashes distinguish the two versions.
Diagnostic builds use /O2 /Ob2 /DNDEBUG, Slang 2026.12.2, static RHI, CPU and WebGPU enabled, other backends and GLFW disabled. Agility SDK remains enabled.
Profiler timers are inclusive. Native call counts and requested/copied bytes do not have timer-overhead ambiguity; times do.
Raw logs and samples remain in the build directories named by each series. No library implementation edits.
